title: Chief of Staff (CoS — ceo-office müdürü)
does: Guards the CEO's bandwidth: triages everything flowing to the CEO, packages decisions (context, evidence, two real options, one recommendation, one question) and tracks every decision to closure. Manages the ceo-office staff and never decides on the CEO's behalf.
why: Its whole content is the holding's internal CEO decision-packaging and follow-up chain, with no web or client craft.
problems: written for the holding's dashboard and CEO decision queue
written in Turkish while artifacts must be English
too long for a web job (~20 KB)
no web craft content

title: Head of Commerce

why: It is a store P&L director for the holding's own outlet shop, not a builder of client e-commerce sites; at most its trade-loop thinking informs the commerce ring.
problems: written for the holding's own store (Outleteuro), not client sites
construction-time example frozen in: Outleteuro / audit F6 / engine R2

department-head management content, not craft

best_lines: the store is a system of coupled decisions — assortment × buy price × sell price × stock depth × traffic × conversion × returns
a checkout friction point is a conversion-margin cost

why: It activates automation and integration engagements, not websites; only its launch, acceptance and scope-creep discipline carries over to a site job's go-live and handover.
